force_track.baseline: Single central-pixel flux estimate, with the true background and PSF known
force_track.demonstrated_value: Lower flux uncertainty by using the full PSF while fitting a background
force_track.scope: Declared control only; not a survey-wide scientific guarantee

dig_floor.baseline: A 5-sigma test on each exposure separately
dig_floor.demonstrated_value: Recovers the correct supplied trajectory by combining subthreshold exposures
dig_floor.scope: Declared control only; not a survey-wide scientific guarantee

judge_line.baseline: Accepting a high joint score alone
judge_line.demonstrated_value: Flags a candidate driven by one exposure
judge_line.scope: Declared control only; not a survey-wide scientific guarantee

inject_tracks.baseline: Assuming a nominal sensitivity implies track recovery
inject_tracks.demonstrated_value: Actually reruns the search on zero-flux and bright injections; preserves input pixels
inject_tracks.scope: Declared control only; not a survey-wide scientific guarantee

map_cover.baseline: Counting a predicted position inside image bounds as usable coverage
map_cover.demonstrated_value: Rejects masked detector area and does not invent non-detections
map_cover.scope: Declared control only; not a survey-wide scientific guarantee

weigh_stamp.baseline: Equal integrated positive flux for a trail and a spike
weigh_stamp.demonstrated_value: Distinguishes their pixel morphologies under the supplied model family
weigh_stamp.scope: Declared control only; not a survey-wide scientific guarantee

learn_null.baseline: Uniform hypothesis weights and choosing the first listed follow-up
learn_null.demonstrated_value: Uses supplied detection efficiencies to update probabilities and select information
learn_null.scope: Declared control only; not a survey-wide scientific guarantee

map_complete.baseline: Independent-survey union calculation gives 0.75 for one shared exposure
map_complete.demonstrated_value: Returns the correct 0.5 union by retaining shared-exposure dependence
map_complete.scope: Declared control only; not a survey-wide scientific guarantee

inject_all.baseline: Exact enumeration refuses 24 exposures under its declared resource limit
inject_all.demonstrated_value: Computes a selection estimate with Monte Carlo uncertainty, checked against an analytic answer
inject_all.scope: Declared control only; not a survey-wide scientific guarantee

match_all.demonstrated_value: Finds the globally optimal compatible assignment for the supplied candidates
match_all.scope: Declared control only; not a survey-wide scientific guarantee

verify_match.baseline: Trusting a solver report without checking its certificate
verify_match.demonstrated_value: Accepts the valid result and rejects a tampered objective
verify_match.scope: Declared control only; not a survey-wide scientific guarantee

prove_floor.baseline: Known-template oracle bound ignores uncertainty over 20 templates
prove_floor.demonstrated_value: Produces a tighter prior-average power bound under the stated Gaussian model
prove_floor.scope: Declared control only; not a survey-wide scientific guarantee

kepler-propagate.demonstrated_value: Matches the analytic two-body circular solution
kepler-propagate.scope: Declared control only; not a survey-wide scientific guarantee

ejector_fit.baseline: Assigning one common launch time to two distinct ejections
ejector_fit.demonstrated_value: Fits distinct encounter times sharing one source state within the declared model
ejector_fit.scope: Declared control only; not a survey-wide scientific guarantee

find_frames.baseline: Concatenating duplicate archive rows and mistaking a failed service for no coverage
find_frames.demonstrated_value: Queries multiple services, deduplicates the native frame, and retains the failed-provider status
find_frames.scope: Declared control only; not a survey-wide scientific guarantee

check_frames.baseline: Trusting stored responses and successful query labels
check_frames.demonstrated_value: Detects a modified response and distinguishes query success from complete coverage
check_frames.scope: Declared control only; not a survey-wide scientific guarantee

network: Local HTTP archive controls; no assumption about public archive uptime
limits: Fixed controlled cases and stated baselines. Passing is not a discovery, global completeness, or calibrated real-survey false-positive rate.
